# `aitbc node chains`

List chains hosted on all nodes or a specific node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node chains [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--show-private` | flag | `false` | no | Show private chains |
| `--node-id` | text | — | no | Specific node ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node chains
```
